description: Searches Google Scholar and returns up to 20 publications (title, url, publication, snippet, cited_by, cites_id), optionally limited to a range of publication years. Use it for academic papers and citation counts. It does not return full texts, is not for patents (use search_patents) and is not general web search (use google_search). Required: query.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the interface and results, e.g. "en" or "de". Omit for the source default, en.

page.description: Zero-based results page, integer from 0: 0 is the first page, 1 the second, e.g. 1. Omit for the first page; each page is a separate charged call.

query.description: Scholarly search text, 1-500 characters, e.g. "retrieval augmented generation"; author: and source: operators work.

results.description: Maximum publications returned, integer 1-20, default 10, e.g. 5.

year_from.description: Earliest publication year included, four digits, e.g. 2020. Must not be after year_to. Omit for no lower bound.

year_to.description: Latest publication year included, four digits, e.g. 2026. Omit for no upper bound.

name: search_scholar
title: Search Scholar
